description: Search job listings published on Level (jobsbylevel.com), an AI job board that rates every listing by how central AI is to the role, from Little AI (AI Level 1) to Builds AI (AI Level 4). Filters: free-text query, AI level range, remote, city, company, posting age. Returns at most 20 results per page. With `query`: whole-word search with stemming ("engineer" also matches "engineering", but a fragment like "eng" alone no longer matches), ranked by relevance, and `total` is capped at 1,000 (see `total_capped` in the response). Without `query`: ranked by AI rating and recency, `total` is exact. Every result links back to its canonical page on jobsbylevel.com. This tool never returns a direct link to the employer's ATS. Ranking never depends on payment: paid or boosted listings get no priority here.

city.description: City or location text, partial match against the listing's location.

posted_within_hours.description: Only listings posted in the last N hours (1 to 168). 24 = posted today.

query.description: Free text: job title, tool or skill (also matches company name).

remote.description: true to keep remote roles only.

sort.description: "recent" = newest first. Default: relevance with `query`, otherwise AI rating then recency.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Level job listings
